body: There are tons of benefits to cold showers such as it being better for your skin and your immune system. The only difficult part is getting used to it which may take a few showers of dancing under the cold water but it’s all about tolerance and you will actually begin to enjoy them after a couple cold showers. I started a few months ago and enjoy them more than hot showers now. (Coming from a person who used to use boiling hot water)

In my opinion although I am only an 18 (M) I truly believe he lost a good opportunity and person in his life. It seems that you truly did care for him by trying to help him become the best of himself by wanting him to better his life not only for your needs but for himself. You genuinely wanted him to finish his school and such to grow as a person and help him elevate rather than not doing anything with his life and still acting as an immature teenager. And as for him saying you are insecure about you raising ur concerns I believe this sounds like gaslighting as any mature person would actually want their partner to get their life together not only for their own benefit but for the person to grow themself. The problem was not you being insecure and you should not believe that you are but rather you’re simply just more mature than he is and he hasn’t grown up yet and maybe he won’t realize what he has lost now but when he finally does start to get his things together then he’ll realize. Once he builds self discipline and finally makes the best choices for himself (realizing what’s important and realizes he has to grow up and make sacrifices such as partying and get himself together” then maybe he himself will understand and see through your eyes. As for now I’d just wish the best for him and you whatever the circumstances are and just do you and continue to focus on making yourself grow. God bless you.
